source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Corrects 136 reward rules on 47 cards whose stored number contradicted the rule's own text, plus 12 caps stated in points but stored as rupees. Every value is arithmetic on figures already in the rule's own sentence at the card's own point value - nothing researched, nothing guessed. Corrections only ever lower a displayed rate; where the prose claims MORE than we show (10 rules) the number is left alone and reported, because issuer marketing overstates. IDFC FIRST EARN's base is fixed from its own rule text ('0.5% base'); Paytm HDFC Mobile's two representations are made to agree but its value is still unverified and needs HDFC's own document.
